background_initial:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production 2D point-and-click game background Z4_bg.png.
Create ONE full-canvas landscape 16:9 image, target 2048x1152 pixels.
Input references: H1_bg.png is painterly surface/wood style; agata_sheet.png is ONLY to judge ground value contrast, do NOT paint the character; Z2_bg.png and Z3_bg.png are the principal exterior style references, same hand-painted soft detailed Northern Russian village world.
Scene: "lane by the post office", Russian North circa 1900–1920, late autumn, cloudy daylight. Fixed slightly elevated 3/4 camera, horizon around 45% canvas height. On LEFT, close side log wall of Evdokia's house, simple side porch with EXACTLY THREE wooden steps, a closed wooden door, iron door handle and hinge hardware, modest small wooden canopy. Show only plausible exterior hardware, no exterior padlock. On RIGHT, the front facade of a modest wooden village post office: one closed entrance door, one window, a plain completely EMPTY wooden rectangular signboard, a small old iron glazed lantern ABOVE the door, lantern wholly unlit and glass empty. Wooden walkway follows the post-office front. In centre a comfortably broad open walking lane of compact damp earth leads into a visible street opening in the distance; broad unobstructed foreground walking area.
Ground: cool light grey-taupe wet compact soil clearly LIGHTER and COOLER than Agata's brown coat; only THREE OR FOUR discrete shallow reflective puddles, no continuous mud, a little fallen ochre leaf litter along edges. Damp wood and small damp highlights. Calm, tactile, melancholic but readable.
Layer plan: the bottom-left corner is reserved for a separate foreground fence; LEAVE IT EMPTY OF FENCE. Far upper-left edge reserved for separate sparse branches; do NOT paint a close tree or bush there. At lower-left edge reserve a small empty strip for later tall-grass overlay; do NOT paint tall grass there. The environment beneath these zones must be finished cleanly. Distant landscape trees may remain very soft and distant.
Painterly natural anatomy of architecture, muted autumn ochres and warm weathered wood, cool sky and road; match the supplied game exterior references. NO people, creatures, animals, writing, letters, numbers, text, watermark, icons or UI. NO falling rain, snow, fog effects, fire, lamps glowing, warm light beams, dynamic lighting. Output background only, opaque, full scene.
background_clean_edit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Z4 background for a 2D game, preserving the exact camera, buildings, door/window/sign/lantern placement and painterly style. Required output landscape16:9, target2048x1152.
Three precise corrections:
1. Remove ALL close or middle-distance bushes and tall grasses around both buildings and along the lane, including all the left orange bush mass and tree branches at top left and the orange branches beside the right house. These are separate future animation layers. Reconstruct the house walls, open sky and bare low ground beneath them. Keep only sparse flat fallen leaf litter, extremely low moss, and tiny distant trees on the far horizon. Remove any near fence from lower-left corner. Leave lower-left corner clear for a later fence overlay. No residual branches, floating leaves, or tall reeds baked into the background.
2. Make compacted earthen lane LIGHT COOL GREY-TAUPE, muted, substantially lighter and cooler than the warm timber. Preserve just three or four shallow separate puddles; drier compacted soil between them. Make broad walkable centre easy to read. No slushy brown mud.
3. Through gap between houses, the lane clearly reaches a CROSS STREET running left to right behind buildings. River beyond can be subtle but the connected cross street must be readable.
Keep LEFT porch with three steps and canopy. No exterior padlock. RIGHT facade retains closed door, blank signboard, window, unlit lantern, wooden boardwalk. Do not add anything else. No people, creatures, signage text, rain/snow, glowing lamps or dynamic light. Opaque background only.

Keep the exact wide full-frame canvas and aspect ratio of the reference, 1672x941 pixels if supported. Do not crop or center the object. Most of the full canvas remains empty transparent.

A close rough weathered wooden fence corner with one thick dark timber post about x=110,y=675 to bottom y=941, and two rough horizontal rails entering from the LEFT frame edge and reaching x=370 near the bottom. The far right end angles back slightly. All visible timber lies within x0–380, y660–941 (the bottom-left 23% width and bottom30% height). Leave the entire rest of frame transparent. This should occlude only the lower-left foreground verge, leaving left porch and central road fully clear. Bottoms are naturally cut off by the lower frame edge. Simple traditional Northern Russian 1900 village fence, no nails sticking out, no ornaments.
Same soft detailed hand-painted style as reference. Brown-grey damp wood, subdued cold overcast highlights, close foreground scale, camera slightly from above. No grass or bush attached, no ground patch, no shadow rectangle, no text, no people. True alpha transparency, NOT checkerboard drawn into image.
tree_initial:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: Z4_sway_tree.png, transparent full-frame wind-animated foliage layer for the attached background.
Use the background only as a coordinate/style reference. Output ONLY one delicate branching cluster of late-autumn tree twigs with a few ochre leaves, on genuine transparent alpha. NO environment, house, ground, sky, fence, people or text.
Preserve the reference's FULL wide canvas 1672x941,16:9. Do NOT crop, do NOT center the object.
Position the twigs in the UPPER LEFT framing corner only: they ENTER from the LEFT frame border between y=30 and y=230, branch upward and right, with fine tips reaching x=300 maximum and y=330 maximum. Some twigs naturally exit through the top border. The right two-thirds and whole lower half of the canvas are completely transparent. No standalone floating disconnected leaves. No large trunk. Sparse leaves, mostly thin gracefully branching brown wood; suitable for a very subtle 2D sway pivot located outside the left edge.
Match the soft painterly naturalistic game art, damp late-autumn Northern Russia, muted ochre leaves and subdued brown twigs, overcast daylight. Crisp enough contour for compositing, no white halos, no drop-shadow or ground patch. True transparent background, not drawn checkerboard.
